goals: Verify fetching a direct message thread and its associated messages via GraphQL
Verify the pagination and ordering functionality of the message connection in a direct message thread
activities: Send a GraphQL request to fetch a direct message thread by ID
Assert that the result matches the snapshot
Send a GraphQL request to fetch a direct message thread's message connection
Assert that the result matches the snapshot
Send a GraphQL request to fetch the first message in the thread's message connection
Assert that the pageInfo indicates a next page exists but no previous page
Assert that the fetched message content matches the last message in the mock data
Send a GraphQL request to fetch the first message and its cursor in the thread's message connection
Assert that the pageInfo indicates a next page exists but no previous page
Extract the cursor from the fetched message edge
Send a second GraphQL request to fetch the next message using the extracted cursor
Assert that the new pageInfo indicates both next and previous pages exist
Assert that the newly fetched message content matches the second to last message in the mock data
